outcome: quality of the surgical field (small and large intestine evaluation)
cohort: The study included 166 pregnant women at >=39 weeks of gestation undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: Implementation of a preoperative low-residue diet significantly reduced postoperative ileus and pain in women undergoing elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: A preoperative low-residue diet significantly reduced postoperative ileus and pain specifically for women undergoing elective cesarean section.
